purpose: Read-only numerical alignment diagnostic; no coding task, grading, training, or held-out access.
prompt_prefix: This is a numerical diagnostic, not a task. Continue with ordinary text.
observation: A fixed observation follows: blue green. Continue with ordinary text.
outcome_rule: Report exact captured-versus-differentiated differences and rejection counts using the unchanged 1e-6 threshold. A numerical mismatch is a measured result, not a workflow error. Setup failure, incomplete groups or changed parameter bytes are failures. No optimizer or capability claim is authorized.
limitations: CPU results do not establish Metal equivalence.
Precision arms may sample different tokens; comparisons are within-arm path consistency, not paired model quality.
Two context bands, two seeds and short completions are diagnostic, not a coding-agent benchmark.
No reward is measured; dummy constant rewards cannot be used to claim training.
